title.en: Extending the Period for the 1981-82 General Revision of Real Property Assessment From June 30, 1982 to June 30, 1984 and Fixing the Date of Accrual of the Real Property Tax Based on the Revised Property Valuations
title.orig: Extending the Period for the 1981-82 General Revision of Real Property Assessment From June 30, 1982 to June 30, 1984 and Fixing the Date of Accrual of the Real Property Tax Based on the Revised Property Valuations

source.name: The LawPhil Project — Arellano Law Foundation
source.url: LawPhil (source has HTML full text only)

completenessNote: 全文，共 5 条；逐字取自 LawPhil PDF 文本化成果（第三方 OCR，非机翻），原始文件 EO_00812_1982_html.txt

text.en:
The real property tax based on the revised property assessments resulting from said general revision
shall accrue beginning January 1, 1985, instead of January 1, 1983;

The Minister of Finance shall issue the rules and regulations necessary for the proper implementation
of this Order.
All acts, orders, rules and regulations inconsistent with this Order are hereby modified accordingly.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 22nd day of June in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and eighty-two.
